author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, Audi AG gives a unique insight into their use of Unreal Engine to design the Audi F1 livery—and how they are pushing real-time workflows to the limit. 

The talk focuses on their Audi Visualization Unreal Solution platform—in-house tech that leverages the functionality of the Unreal Editor and exposes it to 3D artists in a way that centers on automotive visualization as the primary use case, while ensuring artists and visualization experts are not limited in what they can achieve. 

Watch to see a real-time, in-editor demo as well as technical deep dives into various Unreal Engine workflows, including how the team leverages Substrate—a node-based material authoring framework that replaces fixed shading models with a modular, layered system.

Find out more about using Unreal Engine for automotive here: unrealengine.com/uses/automotive
